settings.video_frame_processing: qwen_omni_utils.process_mm_info defaults (image_patch_size=14, FPS clamp to all frames, bicubic resize to multiples of 28), then the HF Qwen3-Omni video processor inside vLLM (patch 16, merge 2)
settings.time_encoding: vLLM 0.17.1 default second_per_grid_ts=2.0 s per temporal grid (temporal_patch_size=2 at 1 FPS) x position_id_per_seconds=13
settings.seed_scheme: LLM(seed=seed) as in the model card, plus per-request SamplingParams(seed=sha256(f'{seed}-{qa_id}')) when sampling
settings.mm_processor_cache_reason: vLLM 0.17.1 bug: on a processor-cache hit the video item is None and Qwen3-Omni's _maybe_apply_prompt_updates then treats use_audio_in_video as False (assertion on the audio placeholder). Cache disabled; KV prefix caching stays on.
settings.max_num_seqs_reason: vLLM 0.17.1 bug: merge_interleaved_embeddings (use_audio_in_video) separates video/audio embeddings by token counts only, which breaks when one engine step holds multimodal embeddings of >1 request. max_num_seqs=1 = one request per step (also makes greedy independent of batch composition).
settings.long_video_policy: no truncation, no frame dropping: prompts longer than max_model_len are recorded as status=error (error_type=prompt_too_long) and score zero
